Explanation:- An odd number is called “Witr'. The meaning of Allah being “Witr' is that there is none equal to Him. The number of rak'ahs of Witr Salah being odd is also the reason that Allah loves the praying of Witr.
(Majma' Bihar-ul-Anwar)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ تَعَالَي قَدْ أَمَدَّكُمْ بِصَلَاةٍ وَهِيَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ مِنْ حُمْرِ النَّعَمِ، وَهِيَ الْوِتْرُ فَجَعَلَهَا لَكُمْ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَي طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب استحباب الوتر رقم: ١٤١٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Kharijah ibn Hudhafah (RA) narrates, “Once the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us and said, Allah “has given you one more Salah. It is better for you than red camels. It is the “Witr' Salah, and Allah has fixed its time as from the Isha Salah until the dawn of Fajr.”

blocks.text: Explanation: Among the Arabs, the red camel was regarded as very costly.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي ﷺ بِثَلَاثٍ: بِصَوْمِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، وَالْوِتْرِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، وَرَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد:٤٦٠/٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates, “My beloved, Muhammad ﷺ, advised me to do three things. “He advised me to fast three days every month, to pray Witr before sleeping, and to pray the two rak'ahs Sunnah of Fajr”.

blocks.text: Explanation:- For those who have the habit of getting up at night, it is better to pray Witr after waking from sleep. If one does not have the habit of getting up at night, one should pray it before
